items.title: Davante Adams: Set for hamstring surgery, eyeing post-bye return
items.text:
Adams is expected to undergo a procedure to address a ruptured hamstring tendon and is targeting a return around the Rams' Week 11 bye or a little thereafter, Ian Rapoport reports.

items.title: Josh Jacobs: Practicing, but Week 7 status TBD
items.text:
Head coach Matt LaFleur said that Jacobs (personal) will get in a full week of practice, but the practice, but the Packers have yet to determine whether he'll be able to make his season debut Sunday in Detroit, Weston Hodkiewicz of the team's official site reports. "We feel he's in a pretty good spot," LaFleur said. "He's been training but he's missed the exposure to football."
